newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize steady to weaker.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize steady to weaker.

text.p: Argentine cash maize was steady to weaker in good volume trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with plentiful harvest supply weighing on prices, traders said.

The FAS elevator maize price in Buenos Aires was steady at $110. Spot soybeans lost $3 to $290 in Rosario in moderate volume trade affected by lower Chicago prices. Sunflower seed was mixed, gaining $3 in Rosario to $217 and losing $2 in Buenos Aires to $212, in thin trade. Bahia Blanca wheat was unchanged at $158 in slow trade, but forward wheat lost ground in line with lower international prices.
